annotationRationale: Symmetric endpoint vectors cancel their displacements along the hypotenuse, leaving identical vector pairs. Scalar multiplication and the hypotenuse-median theorem give the final magnitude.
sourceMethod: Followed the official symmetric-pair method, expressing each pair as twice the vector to the hypotenuse midpoint and supplying the midpoint-length calculation.

review.mathCheck: Equal spacing makes each pair \(P_i,P_{2025-i}\) symmetric about H, so its vector sum is \(2\vec{BH}\). There are 1012 disjoint pairs. Independently, \(AC=2\) and the hypotenuse median has length 1, giving resultant length 2024, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA #7 (p.4). Midpoint cancellation produces the same vector as the reflected-apex construction in the official figure, with a self-contained algebraic justification.
review.annotationCheck: The key is correct. Pair indexing avoids omissions and double counting; identical directions justify scaling the vector before taking its length. No additional figure is needed.
